cues.zh: 選 Social Network Ads。

cues.zh: 現在能全部執行。

cues.en: And to do this, well we're gonna click Runtime here and then simply Run all.
cues.zh: 點 Runtime，再 Run All。

cues.en: And let's just start from here.
cues.zh: 從這裡開始。

cues.en: Okay, great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Our k_nearest_neighbors classifier was created and trained properly and at the end so all the predictions are generated again.
cues.zh: KNN 分類器已正確建立、訓練，所有預測也重新產生。

cues.en: We can actually have a look at them, and, wow, we seem to have some great predictions that remember on the Test set.
cues.zh: 看一下，似乎很準確，記得這是測試集。

cues.en: So all this is correct.
cues.zh: 這些都對。

cues.en: Here we have an incorrect prediction meaning that the K-NN predicted this particular customer to buy the SUV, whereas in reality that customer didn't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 這裡錯誤，KNN 預測會買 SUV，但實際沒買。

cues.en: Then all this is correct, all correct, all correct.
cues.zh: 接著全部正確。

cues.en: It seems really good.
cues.zh: 看起來很好。

cues.en: Here we have another incorrect prediction this time the opposite one, our model predicted that this particular customer didn't buy the SUV whereas in reality, that customer bought the SUV.
cues.zh: 這裡還有一筆錯誤預測，這次恰好相反：模型預測這位顧客沒有買 SUV，但實際上他買了 SUV。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: Correct. All correct, all correct.
cues.zh: 正確，這些都正確。

cues.en: So pretty good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Wow. I think we actually have very very few incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 錯誤似乎非常少。

cues.en: Let's actually check it out right now.
cues.zh: 現在確認。

cues.en: Okay, no, so I didn't see it properly, but we actually have in total four plus three incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 剛才沒有看清楚，總共 4+3 筆錯誤。

cues.en: That's really, really good.
cues.zh: 非常好。

cues.en: That's better than the logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 比邏輯斯迴歸更好。

cues.en: Remember, we had actually an accuracy of the Test set of 89%.
cues.zh: 記得邏輯斯迴歸測試準確率是 89%。

cues.en: So here, clearly, the K_nearest_neighbors did better than the logistic regression model.
cues.zh: KNN 明顯表現更好。

cues.en: And you will perfectly understand why when I show you the visualization.
cues.zh: 看視覺化，你就完全知道原因。

cues.en: So it's actually here.
cues.zh: 在這裡。

cues.en: Alright, so four plus three equals seven incorrect predictions, then 64 correct predictions of the class zero meaning 64, correct predictions
cues.zh: 4+3=7 筆錯誤，類別 0 正確 64 筆，也就是 64 次正確預測

cues.en: that the customer doesn't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 顧客不買 SUV。

cues.en: And 29 correct predictions of the class one.
cues.zh: 類別 1 正確 29 筆。

cues.en: Meaning 29, correct predictions that the customer buys the SUV.
cues.zh: 也就是 29 次正確預測顧客購買。

cues.en: And then we have indeed four incorrect predictions of the class one.
cues.zh: 類別 1 有四次錯誤預測，

cues.en: Meaning four incorrect predictions that the customer buys the SUV.
cues.zh: 也就是四次錯誤預測會買。

cues.en: And three incorrect predictions of the class zero.
cues.zh: 類別 0 有三次錯誤預測，

cues.en: Meaning three incorrect predictions that the customer doesn't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 也就是三次錯誤預測不買。

cues.en: So very, very good.
cues.zh: 非常好。

cues.en: And now as you can see, it is still executing the cell that plots that 2D array, you know, showing all the prediction regions and prediction boundary
cues.zh: 現在儲存格仍在執行，畫出二維圖，顯示全部預測區域與邊界，

cues.en: of the K-NN model first on the Training set and then on the Test set.
cues.zh: 先訓練集，再測試集。

cues.en: And the reason why it is taking some time here to execute, oh, there we go.
cues.zh: 為何要花時間？結果出來了。

cues.en: We are perfect timing.
cues.zh: 時機剛好。

cues.en: Is simply because, you know, the K-NN model is actually very compute intensive.
cues.zh: 因為 KNN 的計算量很大。

cues.en: You know, there are a lot of computations when running the K-NN model, and that's why it took some time.
cues.zh: 執行時需要大量計算，所以比較久。

cues.en: And so now let's interpret the results.
cues.zh: 現在解讀結果。

cues.en: So remember with the logistic regression classifier the prediction boundary was a straight line, and that's because the logistic regression model
cues.zh: 記得邏輯斯迴歸的邊界是直線，因為它

cues.en: is a linear classifier.
cues.zh: 是線性分類器。

cues.en: We'll actually see another type of linear classifier in this part.
cues.zh: 這部分還會看到另一種線性分類器。

cues.en: But remember for linear classifiers, the prediction boundary or prediction curve for classification is a straight line.
cues.zh: 線性分類器的分類邊界，在二維是直線。

cues.en: And in three dimensions it's a straight plane.
cues.zh: 三維是平面。

cues.en: And in N dimension, it's a straight hyperplane.
cues.zh: N 維則是超平面。

cues.en: And so here we had a straight line, which therefore resulted in having a lot of incorrect predictions, because as we can see, there are a lot of green points here.
cues.zh: 之前的直線造成很多錯誤，因為這裡有很多綠點，

cues.en: You know, green customers who bought the SUV in reality that fall in the red region where we predict indeed that the customers don't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 也就是實際買車的人，落在預測不買的紅區。

cues.en: And same for these ones here.
cues.zh: 這裡也相同。

cues.en: You know, here we have a lot of customers who in reality bought the SUV, but we're predicting not to because they fall in the red region.
cues.zh: 實際買了，卻因落在紅區而被預測沒買。

cues.en: And so what we're hoping for is to build a new classifier for which the decision boundary, you know, separating the two prediction regions, does something like this, you know, would not be
cues.zh: 所以希望新分類器的邊界不再

cues.en: a straight line but some kind of a curve catching all the red points here without catching those grid points here and here, okay?
cues.zh: 是直線，而是某種曲線，抓住紅點，避開這兩邊綠點。

cues.en: So that's what we were hoping for and well that's exactly what we got here.
cues.zh: 這正是希望得到，也確實得到的。

cues.en: Thanks to our K-NN model, we don't get a smooth curve, but we get actually some kind of a curve that indeed catches all the red points here without catching the green points
cues.zh: KNN 的曲線不平滑，但能抓住紅點，不抓綠點，

cues.en: and leaving those grid points and these ones inside the green region where they should end up, right?
cues.zh: 讓這些綠點都留在應該的綠色區域。

cues.en: And of course here we have some green points that were super hard to catch, because they are stuck in the middle of all those red points here.
cues.zh: 當然這裡有些綠點被紅點包住，很難正確抓到。

cues.en: So that's fine in any way in machine learning we want to avoid over fitting, you know when we have some two perfect predictions on Training set and therefore probably resulting
cues.zh: 沒關係，機器學習要避免過度擬合，也就是訓練集太完美，可能導致

cues.en: in having bad performance, bad predictions on the Test set.
cues.zh: 測試集表現差、預測差。

cues.en: And while speaking of the Test set, let's see how our K-NN did.
cues.zh: 說到測試集，看看 KNN 表現。

cues.en: It should be fine now.
cues.zh: 現在應該完成了。

cues.en: Yes, it is executed and once again, we get excellent results right?
cues.zh: 沒錯，結果同樣非常好。

cues.en: Because same, the K-NN prediction curve or prediction boundary or even decision boundary catches all the right customers.
cues.zh: KNN 的預測曲線、預測邊界或決策邊界，抓住正確的顧客。

cues.en: You know, the red customers who didn't buy in reality the SUV, therefore leaving the green customers who bought in reality the SUV in the right prediction region,
cues.zh: 實際沒買的紅點在正確區域，買了的綠點也留在正確的

cues.en: the green region.
cues.zh: 綠色區域。

cues.en: Alright? So that's already much better.
cues.zh: 已經改善很多。

cues.en: And indeed we increased the accuracy of the Test set by 4%.
cues.zh: 測試準確率提高了 4%。

cues.en: And now the question is, can we do even better than this?
cues.zh: 那還能更好嗎？

cues.en: Well, that's exactly what we're gonna find out in the next practical activities to discover the big winner.
cues.zh: 接下來的實作會揭曉，找出大贏家。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
